clang:
clang version 23.1.0-wasi-sdk (https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project 895aa2c896ada719451be2e3673c83da8ddf1141)
Target: wasm32-unknown-wasip1
Thread model: posix
engine: Wasmtime 38.0.4 / Cranelift; identical EH/gc-drc settings for all modules
experiment: v3 inline static-region reservation, per-op dynamic-factor rounding, exact cold fault checks, no C++ exceptions
methodology_notes: Same Clang23.1.0-wasi-sdk and Wasmtime38.0.4 engine settings for all variants. V1/v3 link freestanding with Rust1.91.1 bundled rust-lld; v2 links libc++abi/libunwind with wasi-sdk34 driver.
Three rotated compile/link rounds; nine rotating-order warmed batches per workload. Every timing sample retained.
The v3 histogram groups static costs while preserving per-op factor rounding; the successful path is inline and has no per-op resource checks.
Planner counts describe the entire decoded bytecode including unreachable portions, not dynamic counts per call.
No databases or mainnet services are part of these timings. Other workload/host results can differ.
